text:
maya: Hey team — kicking off onboarding for hippo-3b (community fork). Need a quick pass on: weights location, tokenizer quirks, serving config validation, and whether the license blocks enterprise Dedicated/Private use.

maya: We have weights uploaded here: `s3://redwood-models/hippo/hippo-3b/weights/v1/hippo-3b-8bit.pt` and a draft model card at `https://internal.redwood.com/model-cards/hippo-3b.md` (private).

maya: Quick notes I saw: tokenizer is sentencepiece, max seq 4096, authorship attributed to HippoAI, and license field in model card says `CC-BY-NC-4.0` (copy pasted). I haven’t touched serving config yet.

kevin: Re: weights path — ok, we can pull from that S3. Can you confirm the snapshot checksum? also which quantization profile was used? 8bit is fine but we need quant-profile metadata for reproducibility.

maya: checksum: `sha256:3a7f2b...9c1` (I’ll add to the card). quant_profile: `hippo-q8-v2` (applied via conversion script).

kevin: thanks. Two runtime flags we need to change for hippo-3b in prod-config.yaml:
```yaml
model_name: hippo-3b
dtype: int8
tokenizer: sentencepiece
max_seq_len: 4096
kv_cache: true
quant_profile: hippo-q8-v2
```
kevin: Also note: sentencepiece file uses a nonstandard `unk_id=0` and BOS/EOS are swapped (BOS=2, EOS=1). That breaks our default decode if we don't map them in TokenizerWrapper. I can add a small adapter but need QA on tokenization roundtrip.

sam: I’ll add a CI check: tokenization roundtrip for a small text corpus (en + fr + emoji) and an integration smoke test calling the runtime for 128 and 512 token generations.

alex: Legal here. NC (non-commercial) license is a gating condition. CC-BY-NC-4.0 prohibits commercial use — that blocks usage in Dedicated and Private for paying enterprise customers unless we get an explicit license from the model authors. For Hosted (research/demo) usage we could allow it with strict attribution and a visible disclaimer but not for revenue-bearing contracts.

alex: Required items to clear onboarding:
- model_card URL + full license text
- author contact / attribution string to display
- signed permission or dual-license for enterprise use (if customer-facing)
- list of third-party weights/tokenizer deps and their licenses
- export-control check (if any non-US tech in training)

governance-bot: license_check FAILED for hippo-3b: detected `CC-BY-NC-4.0` (NC clause). Blocking flag applied: `blocked_for_enterprise=true`. See /governance/logs/1773012345 for details.

irene: Product note — if legal blocks enterprise, we should still be able to run a Hosted research preview (limited quotas) to surface quality. We’ll need a clear banner in the Console and gating in the API docs.

maya: Understood. Alex — can you advise what messaging we should surface in the model listing if we allow hosted research preview only? I can update the model-card and Console banner.

alex: For hosted preview: require a bold license badge: `License: CC-BY-NC-4.0 (research/demo only)` and an attribution line: `Model by HippoAI — used under CC-BY-NC-4.0`. Also add a checkbox in the onboarding UI: "I acknowledge this model is restricted to non-commercial use" and audit log the acceptance.

kevin: Technical follow-ups: I’ll patch TokenizerWrapper to remap BOS/EOS and add a small conversion test. I also want to avoid 4-bit profiles for this model unless we validate perplexity regressions — stick to q8 for now. Can someone drop a short eval set?

sam: I’ll add the tests and a small eval harness in PR #1823. I’ll include latency/throughput numbers at 128/256/512 tokens and tokenization roundtrip.

maya: Next steps (taking ownership):
- update model card with checksum, license text, author contact (today)
- add Console badge + UI checkbox (irene + product)
- sam to add CI tests (tomorrow)
- kevin to patch tokenizer mapping + runtime config (tomorrow)
- alex to add gating rule to governance console (legal)

maya: pinging @alex and @governance-bot for final gate decision once I push updated card. :thumbsup:

alex: please include author email (or PR link) so legal can try to negotiate a commercial license if product wants enterprise.

governance-bot: note: automated export-control scan passed (no flagged datasets).
